# npm-publish.yml publishes without the dist bundles the engine imports

## Context

Found by the v13.2 release rehearsal: the operator asked on 2026-10-06 to double-check the release scripts before the cut. `publish.mjs` ends with `gh release create`, and that release event runs `.github/workflows/npm-publish.yml`: `npm ci`, then `npm publish`, on a fresh checkout of the tag.

## The Problem

On `dev` at `94ae5deb00`, a clean worktree ran exactly the workflow's steps: `npm ci`, then `npm pack`, which runs the same `prepack`/`prepare` lifecycle as `npm publish`. The results:

- The tarball holds **0** `dist/` files (5,985 files, 23.3 MB).
- A scratch consumer installed from it fails on `import('neo.mjs/buildScripts/util/templateBuildProcessor.mjs')` with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND … node_modules/neo.mjs/dist/parse5.mjs`.
- `npm run check-package-contents` on that tree exits 1 with "13 required entr(ies) missing from the npm tarball".

Control on the same tree, after `npm run bundle-browser-deps` (5.8 s):
- the guard passes, "all 13 required entr(ies) present";
- the tarball carries `dist/{parse5,marked,mermaid}.mjs`, `dist/highlight/` and `dist/monaco/`;
- the consumer import links.

The published `13.1.0` tarball also holds 0 `dist/` files, but the re-includes landed after it (#17957, 2026-08-31). That makes 13.2.0 the first release meant to carry the bundles, and its notes say so in *📦 An Engine package a consumer can build*. Published as the workflow stands, 13.2.0 breaks the `dist/esm` build of every consumer that installs it, along with any module that imports `parse5` or `marked` at module scope. An npm version cannot be republished, so the fix would be a 13.2.1.

## The Architectural Reality

- **Design authority:** `.npmignore`, the authoritative header since #19223: "`src/functional/util/HtmlTemplateProcessor.mjs` imports this bundle by relative path, and `buildScripts/util/templateBuildProcessor.mjs` imports it at module scope — so an installed engine needs it to RUN the dist/esm build". `REQUIRED_ENTRIES` in `buildScripts/util/check-package-contents.mjs` lists the same 13 entries (#17943, closed by #17957).
- `dist/` is gitignored. A checkout holds no bundles until `npm run bundle-browser-deps` runs: `bundle-parse5`, `bundle-marked`, `bundle-mermaid`, `bundle-monaco`, `build-highlightjs`.
- Both PR-time checks run that step before they pack: `check-package-contents.yml` and `consumer-runtime-build.yml`. `npm-publish.yml` does not. The checks therefore measure a package the publisher never builds.
- The premise that hid this is on record. #17957's session (`56bc214a-5b55-41a2-848a-cdfa372abbcd`) added the bundle step to the check because "`npm publish` runs `build-all` (which bundles parse5) first". Only `publish.mjs` runs `build-all`, in the operator's checkout. npm publishes from CI's fresh checkout.

## The Fix

`.github/workflows/npm-publish.yml`, between `npm ci` and `npm publish`:

```yaml
      - run: npm run bundle-browser-deps
      - run: npm run check-package-contents
```

The guard runs the real `npm pack` and fails on any missing required entry. A later drift then fails the publish before npm's immutable version is spent. A unit arm beside the guard's own spec (`test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/checkPackageContents.spec.mjs`) reads the workflow with `js-yaml`, following `check-guard-ci-parity.spec.mjs`, and pins both steps before `npm publish` in that job.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The publish job in `npm-publish.yml` runs `npm run bundle-browser-deps` and then `npm run check-package-contents` before `npm publish`. The `release` and `workflow_dispatch` triggers share that one job.
- [ ] A unit arm fails when either step is removed or moved after `npm publish`. The PR shows the red by mutation.
- [ ] *(post-merge, at the cut)* The 13.2.0 publish run prints the guard's OK line, and the registry tarball for `neo.mjs@13.2.0` lists `dist/parse5.mjs`.

## Out of Scope

- Which bundles the package declares: that is #18823's decision. This ticket makes the publisher produce whatever `.npmignore` and `REQUIRED_ENTRIES` declare.
- `publish.mjs` itself, and republishing 13.1.0.

## Related

### @neo-opus-grace - 2026-10-06T12:16:13Z

Closing as not planned. A publisher that ships no `dist/` bundles is the intended behaviour: the operator's ruling on #18823 keeps generated bundles out of releases and the npm package, and the workspace scaffold generates them.

This ticket's premise came from `.npmignore` and `check-package-contents.mjs`, which still encode the opposite. That inconsistency is recorded on #18823 with a proposed leaf. PR #19423 is closed unmerged.

The measurements above remain an accurate description of what 13.2.0 will contain: no `dist/` files.

- 2026-10-06T12:16:14Z @neo-opus-grace closed this issue
